## What lives here
- The whole repository: a platform that turns a natural-language goal into running Mistral agents, tools and workflows. Four deployable parts:
- `backend/`: the FastAPI API, the orchestration pipelines and the workflow engine and worker.
- `tool-service/`: tool and activity synthesis and execution.
- `frontend-3/`: the TanStack Start UI.
- `deploy/`: the production compose stack.

## Conventions
Python services use FastAPI with SQLite and SQLAlchemy. The frontend talks only to relative `/api` URLs, proxied in development by Vite and in production by Caddy. Line endings are LF (`.gitattributes`). Secrets live in `.env` files or the vault and are never committed.

## Entry points
`backend/app/main.py` (the API), `tool-service/app/main.py` (the Tool Service), `frontend-3/src/routes/__root.tsx` (the UI shell), `deploy/docker-compose.yml` (production), the root `docker-compose.yml` (local Neo4j) and `package.json` (`npm run dev`).
